blocks.text: *The official guide to **Unwritten** — a 2.5D MMORPG where you restore the corrupted pages of an artist's unfinished book and write your own color into it.*

text: **Status:** Living wiki, in active development. Pages reflect the current design; anything marked *planned* or *in tuning* isn't final yet. Numbers and rosters are still being balanced before launch.

blocks.text: An artist wrote a gentle story in a book and drew its pictures himself. Then unwanted thoughts took shape in his mind as **Chaos**, and Chaos **corrupted the pages** — the drawings on them twisted into **monsters**. The fourteen champions he imagined to stop it sealed it away, but his fear that Chaos had infected them turned them into the **fourteen shadows**.

You are one of the **unwritten** — real in the artist's mind but not yet on the page: a charcoal body with no color. You restore the corrupted pages and face the shadows, and as you are written in, your **color arrives**. That gradual arrival of self *is* your progression.
The look of the game is the story: the flat, papery monsters **are** the corrupted pages; the 3D-but-colorless heroes **are** the people not yet written.

**Combat Mechanics** — damage types, elements, and matchups

**Crafting & Recycling** — forge, fold, quench, write stats with Ink, and recycle

**Materials** — every crafting material and every monster that drops it
**World Map** — every map, its view from above, and the monsters on it
**Elements** — the element chart at levels 1 to 4
**Roadmap** — one timeline of what has been built and what is coming next

blocks.text: *The Database pages are written by the game from its own data; every other page is authored from the game's design canon. Sections labeled "planned," "design intent," or "in tuning" are not final and will be updated as the design locks.*
